name: st-styling-0822
title: In-game styling (0.8.22): ST1-ST12, dark then light
requires: The XF test profile with the bridge's -writes build staged (0.8.22 or later); the runner sets config.ini's [overlay] and [ui] keys per row and restores the file at the end.
A private fixtures file (--fixtures): mo2 {exe, profile, executable, arguments: -skipStartScreen}, game_dir, staged_mod, save, cet_overlay_key (Ctrl+` here), commit_floor_gb.
Borderless windowed, the game window in front; Windows' Do Not Disturb on (focus-taking toasts stopped the Borg 4 key press).
Captures are evidence for XF · Studio's UI review; a PASS here means the state and the capture, not the design verdict.

requires.note: the player turns Windows' Animation effects off and back; set allow_windows_animation_check in the fixtures to run it

steps.text: ST9: please turn Windows' Settings > Accessibility > Visual effects > Animation effects OFF, then press Done.

steps.label: ST9b-dark-on
steps.text: ST9: thank you. Please turn Animation effects back ON, then press Done.
